source: The purpose of tiling is not simply “make tensors smaller.” It is to increase reuse while a tile is resident on chip. A block ofZXMATH0000XZ can interact with multipleZXMATH0001XZ blocks before its partial softmax/output state is written back. Conversely,ZXMATH0002XZ blocks can be streamed through query blocks according to the chosen schedule.
zh: 平铺的目的不仅仅是“让张量更小”。这是为了在块驻留在芯片上时增加重用。在写回其部分 softmax/输出状态之前，ZXMATH0000XZ 块可以与多个 ZXMATH0001XZ 块进行交互。相反，ZXMATH0002XZ 块可以根据所选计划通过查询块进行流式传输。
